<title>riscv-unprivileged-20250508</title>
<section>Chapter 31. Cryptography Extensions: Scalar & Entropy Source Instructions, Version 1.0.1 > 31.4. Instructions > 31.4.11. aes64ks2 > Operation</section>
<previous>#### **Description**

This instruction implements the additional XOR’ing of key words as part of the AES block cipher Key Schedule. This instruction must _always_ be implemented such that its execution latency does not depend on the data being operated on.</previous>
<target>#### **Operation**

```
function clause execute (AES64KS2(rs2, rs1, rd)) = {
  let w0 : bits(32) = X(rs1)[63..32] ^ X(rs2)[31..0];
  let w1 : bits(32) = X(rs1)[63..32] ^ X(rs2)[31..0] ^ X(rs2)[63..32];
  X(rd)  = w1 @ w0;
  RETIRE_SUCCESS
}
```</target>
